svg.title: OSI model to TCP/IP model mapping
svg.desc: Side-by-side diagram showing how OSI's seven layers map to TCP/IP's four layers, with protocols listed for each TCP/IP layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Application layer in OSI')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Presentation layer in OSI')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Session layer in OSI')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Transport layer in OSI')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Network layer in OSI')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Data Link layer in OSI')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Physical layer in OSI')
sendPrompt('What protocols live in the TCP/IP Application layer?')
g.text: HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, SMTP, SSH, FTP

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What protocols live in the TCP/IP Transport layer?')
g.text: TCP, UDP — maps to OSI layer 4

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What protocols live in the TCP/IP Internet layer?')
g.text: IP, ICMP — maps to OSI layer 3

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What protocols live in the TCP/IP Network Access layer?')
